I would highly recommend veterinarian Monica at Romsås Dyreklinikk. She is caring, warm and knowledgeable. She takes her time and I always feel confident that my beloved pets are in the best hands! She was a solid support for us when we had to make the most difficult choice <3
Monica and company are always loving and caring about our family members. As long as we have had our little ones Monica has been there for us.

Very skilled and good veterinarians who put the animal first before price and whether you have insurance. Recommended
Monica at Romsås Animal Clinic is a skilled veterinarian and a true animal lover. I give her my highest recommendations! 🌺 …

Thank you Monica for making the difficult process of Lillo's end of life a good experience.

I wanted my boy to be laid to rest at home in his own bed. It was a nice and memorable moment and Monica handled the process in the most humane and careful way possible and that did not become a traumatic experience for me as the owner.

The price was nothing to say, it would have cost the same, if not more, to go to the chain we have used until now.

Today I picked up the urn, two weeks later, and everything has been a good experience despite all the pain of losing the dearest thing you have ❤️🐾
Incredibly good veterinarians. Good prices.

Monica the vet is incredibly nice and empathetic. She takes her time with the animals and clearly cares that the animals are in the best possible condition.

She was also absolutely fantastic and gave me all the time I needed the day I unfortunately had to euthanize my cat.

Highly recommended!
Very competent doctor.
